lines.3: Crab wasn't here at this time of day.
lines.10: While we waited for the curry, the subject of our classes came up.
lines.11: 「Huh. So even Class 2-A, with all its honor students, has its share of romance.」
lines.13: 「We talk a lot about what kind of guys we like, or what kind we can't stand.」
lines.14: 「So what kind of guys does everyone hate?」
lines.15: 「Narcissists. Like guys who make their dates hold up a mirror so they can check their own face over and over.」
lines.18: 「Guys who do nothing but brag about their exploits, guys who talk about vague dreams, wishy-washy guys, and flashy guys who lie all the time.」
lines.19: 「Some of those hit a little close to home.」
lines.21: 「You could say the same about men.」
lines.22: 「So what kind of girl do you like, Tsushima?」
lines.24: Princess was the first person who came to mind.
lines.25: 「Hmm. I guess I like a girl who has a strong sense of self and stays true to it.」
lines.27: 「I guess I just have a thing for strong-willed girls.」
lines.30: 「Heh. That was some pretty smooth flattery.」
